title: RTX 4070 Ti vs 4080 vs 4090: Best of the bad value (4070 Ti Review, Asus TUF OC model)
description:
This RTX 4070 Ti review focuses on the performance in demanding new engines like Unreal Engine 5, and discusses the value relative to the rest of the RTX 4000 series lineup. Is the RTX 4070 Ti worth it? Let's find out. The RTX 4080 tested was the Founders Edition, and the RTX 4090 was the Gigabyte Gaming OC cooler. All cards were tested at their out-of-the-box settings. The full system specs are below.
